description: pkix-chain-simple defines a private RustCryptoVerifier(pkix_path::DefaultVerifier) newtype with impl Default and impl SignatureVerifier that simply delegates every method to the inner DefaultVerifier. This adds ~20 lines of code with no benefit. verify_simple() could pass &pkix_path::DefaultVerifier directly to pkix_path::validate_path. The wrapper was presumably added to avoid exposing DefaultVerifier in the local call site, but since DefaultVerifier is already a re-export of pkix_path and verify_simple takes no verifier parameter, there is no API surface concern. Delete RustCryptoVerifier and call validate_path(..., &pkix_path::DefaultVerifier) directly.
title: RustCryptoVerifier in pkix-chain-simple is unnecessary boilerplate
